# Independent Abaqus mesh fixtures

These text decks were hand-authored for #502. They were not generated by `write_inp` or by
an installed Abaqus version. Syntax follows the vendor-authored 2025 manuals available
through the Virginia Tech mirror: [input syntax](https://docs.software.vt.edu/abaqusv2025/English/SIMACAEMODRefMap/simamod-c-inputsyntax.htm),
[Sets](https://docs.software.vt.edu/abaqusv2025/English/SIMACAEKEYRefMap/simakey-r-nset.htm),
and [solid connectivity/face tables](https://docs.software.vt.edu/abaqusv2025/English/SIMACAEELMRefMap/simaelm-r-3delem.htm).

`sparse-label-tet.inp`, with `unitLength: "1 m"`, has one positive unit tetrahedron of volume
1/6 m³. Its source element 900 uses labels [40, 10, 70, 20] in the standard tetrahedral
connectivity order. Sorted authored labels are [10, 20, 40, 70, 99]; 99 is an unused coincident
node and must remain in the portable source without acquiring a fabricated FE DOF. The
CAPTURE node Set is [10, 40], while the later SAME node Set is [10, 20, 40]. The separate SAME
element Set is [900]. FROM_ELEMENTS is [10, 20, 40, 70]. Face centroids S1 through S4 are,
respectively, (1/3, 1/3, 0), (1/3, 0, 1/3), (1/3, 1/3, 1/3), (0, 1/3, 1/3) metres.

`far-unused-tet.inp` keeps that same physical tetrahedron and moves unused source node 99 to
(1000000, 1000000, 1000000) metres. Physical Mesh/Body bounds remain [0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1] and
volume remains 1/6 m³. The authored FAR node Set separately retains count 1 and its distant
point bounds; PHYSICAL contains only the four participating labels. This fixture distinguishes
retained source data from physical bounds, volume and viewer framing.

`brick-sets.inp`, with `unitLength: "1 mm"`, has one 1 × 2 × 3 m brick of volume 6 m³.
Sorted source labels are [1, 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25, 29]; element 100 uses them in that standard
brick connectivity order. ALL is retained in both source namespaces. BASE is [1, 5, 9, 13],
ONE is [1], and COPY is [100]. The six surface centroids are independently fixed by the box:
BOTTOM (0.5, 1, 0), TOP (0.5, 1, 3), FRONT (0.5, 0, 1.5), RIGHT (1, 1, 1.5), BACK (0.5, 2, 1.5),
LEFT (0, 1, 1.5), all metres.

The first importer rejects quoted labels and unquoted periods. Ordinary FEM Lab mesh exports
currently contain qualified names such as `beam.xmin`; those are outside this parser subset,
and their export spelling is separately tracked in #518. A writer/reader check using supported
names is supplementary evidence, not the oracle for these fixtures.

`signed-zero-tet.inp` and `signed-zero-hex.inp` independently spell coordinate zeros as both
`-0` and `-0.0`, including the unused Tet node. Their physical bounds/volumes are the same
closed forms above; the SHA-256 still hashes the original exact text. These expose signed-zero
transport fidelity at the Rust serde/JavaScript JSON boundary and persisted replay path.
